story.title: Mission Mirchi: Technician dies in truck crash
story.summary: Filming of ‘Mission Mirchi’, starring Vijay Varma and Jaideep Ahlawat, has reportedly been halted after light boy Pintu Mondal, 46, died in a truck accident near Sikkim’s 5th Mile. The driver lost control on a sharp turn while returning from Tsomgo Lake. The driver is injured, and the makers haven’t commented.
